sources: audit/state_park_fees/co_booking_rates_2026-10-12.jsonl (cpwshop per-site details and prices, loop Hecla Junction, 2027-06-15/19)

values.note: Every Hecla Junction site is $28 a night ($196 a week), the same on a Saturday. A daily vehicle pass ($10-15) or an annual Colorado state parks pass is required on top.

fees.source: https://cpw.state.co.us/state-parks/arkansas-headwaters-recreation-area/arkansas-headwaters-recreation-area-buena-vista (Hecla Junction card: '$28 Per Night') + cpwshop parkID 50067 per-site prices, loop Hecla Junction (all 23 sites '$28.00 /Per Night $196.00 /Per Week' for 06/15/2027; site 1101 the same for Sat 06/19/2027; co_booking_rates_2026-10-12.jsonl) + https://cpw.state.co.us/state-parks/arkansas-headwaters-recreation-area ('Daily Vehicle Pass: $10-$15'), read 2026-10-26

hookups.source: https://cpw.state.co.us/state-parks/arkansas-headwaters-recreation-area/arkansas-headwaters-recreation-area-buena-vista ('Hecla Junction campground offers 23 basic sites'; amenity checklist with 'RV Hook-ups' unchecked) + cpwshop site list (all 23 Hecla Junction sites type 'Basic'), read 2026-10-26

values.note: 23 gravel drive-in basic sites (vehicle lengths 23-83 ft, most 34-59; sites 1112 and 1114 are pull-throughs), 8 of them listed as riverfront; site 1108HA is paved and accessible. Two sites have a severe driveway grade, nine moderate. Little shade.

sites.source: cpwshop parkID 50067 per-site details, loop Hecla Junction (sites 1101-1123: 'Maximum Vehicle Length', 'Driveway Entry', 'Driveway Surface', 'Driveway Grade', 'Proximity to Water', 'Shade'; co_booking_rates_2026-10-12.jsonl) + CPW Buena Vista page ('23 basic sites. Campsite 1108HA is accessible.'), read 2026-10-26

values.note: Vault toilets and changing facilities; no drinking water and no trash cans (pack trash out). Boat ramp at the Browns Canyon take-out.

facilities.source: https://cpw.state.co.us/state-parks/arkansas-headwaters-recreation-area/arkansas-headwaters-recreation-area-buena-vista (Hecla Junction camping checklist: 'Vault Toilets' checked; 'Potable Water', 'RV Hook-ups', 'Trash Cans' unchecked; access-site card: 'Boat Ramp/Slide', 'Restroom'), read 2026-10-26

season.source: https://www.cpwshop.com/camping/arkansas-headwaters-recreation-area/r/campgroundDetails.page?parkID=50067 ('Current Status - Open year round.'; Hecla Junction is one of the listing's loops) + https://cpw.state.co.us/state-parks/arkansas-headwaters-recreation-area ('Park: Open 24 hours a day, year-round'), read 2026-10-26

values.note: 'Camping is allowed by reservation only at all AHRA developed campgrounds. Reservations may be made on the day of arrival or up to six months in advance.' Book on cpwshop.com (AHRA listing, loop Hecla Junction) or 1-800-244-5613.

booking.source: https://cpw.state.co.us/state-parks/arkansas-headwaters-recreation-area/arkansas-headwaters-recreation-area-camping-lodging (quoted) + Buena Vista page ('You can make reservations at either campground online at https://www.cpwshop.com or by calling 1-800-244-5613') + cpwshop Season Schedule (Peak Jan 1 - Dec 31 2026 and 2027), read 2026-10-26

note: CPW-run campground on an open bench above the Arkansas River at Hecla Junction, the take-out for the Browns Canyon run, ~10 mi N of Salida; a 3/4-mile trail runs downstream to Seidel's Suckhole, and Browns Canyon National Monument is reached from here. Reached by a steep narrow dirt access road (~12% grade). --Claude
summary: CPW pages + cpwshop (park listing, per-site data): confirmed 23 basic sites, vault toilets, no drinking water, year-round, reservable on cpwshop, $28 (weekend same); added no hookups, max 83 ft, pull-throughs, booking url/window/fcfs never/year-round. Note: dropped 'Reservable Apr-Oct, FCFS in winter' (CPW: reservation only at every AHRA developed campground, open year-round) and the site/toilet/water/booking restatements; the access-road grade is not on CPW's pages and was kept.
flags: Access road: the note's 'steep narrow dirt access road (~12% grade)' is not stated on CPW's pages (silence, kept). The per-site data rate two driveways 'Severe' and nine 'Moderate'; worth a look at which sites to book for EKKO, not a criteria failure on the evidence.

cpwshop availability grids (cpwgrid.py) returned only 'not available' for every Hecla Junction and Ruby Mountain site and date on 2026-10-26, including a Ruby Mountain January date that booked on an earlier read, so the grid fetch was not trusted and year-round reservability rests on the listing's season schedule.
